nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner (Owned contract).

Number of token decimals (18).

Mapping of holder address to token balance.

Caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances and owner checks.
Overflow-checked addition helper.
Underflow-checked subtraction helper.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper.

onlyOwner function that stages a new owner.
Completes two-step ownership transfer; callable by newOwner.
Token constructor that mints the whole supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens.
Spends allowance and moves tokens between accounts.

Payable fallback that always reverts; rejects ETH.

edges.reason: transfer recipient parameter is used to update balances[to].
transfer amount parameter flows into safeSub/safeAdd balance updates.
approve spender parameter indexes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve amount parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
transferFrom from parameter indexes balances and allowed.
transferFrom to parameter receives the credited balance.
transferFrom tokens parameter is subtracted from balance and allowance.
approveAndCall spender parameter determines the external contract that is called.
approveAndCall tokens parameter is stored as allowance and forwarded.
approveAndCall data parameter is attacker-controlled payload forwarded to the external call.
tokenAddress parameter selects the external contract invoked.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external transfer call.
_newOwner parameter is stored into newOwner.
Owned constructor writes msg.sender into owner.
Owned constructor assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] under caller control.
approve writes into allowed[msg.sender][...] under caller control.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] under caller control.
approveAndCall sets allowance for msg.sender then passes msg.sender into the external call.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier gates the arbitrary external token call.
owner state variable is initialised by the Owned constructor.
acceptOwnership reads the current owner for the OwnershipTransferred event.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner and owner is used as the transfer recipient.
transferOwnership stages newOwner.
acceptOwnership verifies and consumes newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
transferOwnership writes the pending owner slot.
constructor assigns the symbol literal.
constructor assigns the name literal.
constructor assigns decimals.
constructor mints _totalSupply.
constructor credits the full supply into balances of the fixed address.
constructor writes symbol.
constructor writes name.
constructor writes decimals.
constructor writes _totalSupply.
constructor writes the initial balances entry.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply as the first operand.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply without underflow protection.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer updates sender and recipient balances.
transfer relies on safeSub for the debit.
transfer relies on safeAdd for the credit.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approve stores the new allowance.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance.
transferFrom updates both source and destination balances.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the destination credit.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowance before the external call.
approveAndCall updates allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall invokes an external contract through receiveApproval.
The attacker-controlled spender contract can re-enter TaiyuanCoin from receiveApproval.
The spender parameter is the callee address of the unsafe external call.
Attacker-supplied data is forwarded verbatim into the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on the supplied token contract.
tokenAddress parameter is the callee of the external ERC20 transfer.
The arbitrary token contract can call back into TaiyuanCoin during the rescue transfer.
_totalSupply is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
balances[address(0)] is the subtrahend and can exceed _totalSupply only through direct storage manipulation.
totalSupply contains the unchecked uint subtraction that may underflow.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter is only meaningful inside transfer, the core function that consumes it.
Amount parameter is only used by transfer's safeSub/safeAdd balance updates.
Spender parameter is only used to index allowed inside approve.
Amount parameter is only stored as an allowance by approve.
Source parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom.
Destination parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter is only used by transferFrom's debit and credit logic.
Spender parameter is the external target selected by approveAndCall.
Amount parameter is only used for the allowance and event in approveAndCall.
Forwarded calldata is consumed directly by the unsafe external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress parameter selects the callee of the unsafe external ERC20 transfer call.
Amount parameter is only forwarded by transferAnyERC20Token.
_newOwner parameter is only meaningful inside transferOwnership.
